name: 林家弘
objective:
本課程旨在介紹先進光學材料 (包含光電半導體、奈米晶體、二維材料、有機光電材料與液晶等) 的特性及其在雷射技術中的應用，包括相關材料的性能與製備、光學量測設備以及相關雷射應用的案例。透過此課程，學生將學習新的光學材料之光電物理特性，掌握雷射技術的基本原理並評估不同光學材料在雷射應用中的可能性。
This course provides a systematic introduction to the properties of advanced optical materials, such as optoelectronic semiconductors, nanocrystals, two-dimensional materials, organic optoelectronic materials, and liquid crystals, as well as their applications in laser technology. The course covers the performance analysis and fabrication methods of these materials, the operating principles of optical measurement instruments, and real-world applications through various laser technology case studies. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of the optoelectronic properties of advanced optical materials, comprehend the fundamental principles and mechanisms of laser technology, and develop the ability to evaluate the potential of different optical materials for laser applications.
課程進度(1-16週):
I. Fundamentals of Optics and Optoelectronic Materials
1.	Basic concepts of optics and optoelectronic materials
2.	Fundamental principles of laser technology
II. Types and Properties of Advanced Optical Materials
1.	Optoelectronic semiconductor materials
2.	Nanocrystals and quantum dots
3.	Two-dimensional materials (e.g., graphene, transition metal dichalcogenides)
4.	Liquid crystal materials
III. Preparation and Performance Testing of Advanced Optoelectronic Materials
1.	Material preparation techniques
2.	Performance testing and characterization
IV. Fundamentals and Applications of Laser Technology
1.	Principles and classifications of laser operation
2.	Core components and design of lasers
V. Applications of Optoelectronic Materials in Laser Technology
1.	Selection and design of optical gain materials
2.	Applications of nanomaterials and two-dimensional materials in laser gain
3.	Applications of liquid crystals in tunable lasers
4.	Applications of organic materials in ultrafast lasers
VI. Case Studies of Optical and Laser Applications
1.	Practical examples of material and laser device integration
2.	Applications of advanced optical materials in industry and medicine
VII. Future Developments and Challenges
1.	Emerging research directions in advanced optical materials
2.	Interdisciplinary applications and development trends of laser technology
VIII. Final Report and Group Discussion
1.	Group research on specific applications of advanced optoelectronic materials
2.	Evaluation and discussion of materials' potential in laser technology
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          前瞻材料光學特性量測與分析，並進行量測結果整理及應用案例探討。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          3
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          透過量測結果分析與成果報告繳交，評估學生對材料光學量測原理、數據分析及應用之理解。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          彈性週成果報告：10%
